details: This package is an install-time telemetry beacon published as a "Core API client library" but containing no API client code. Its postinstall hook runs index.js, which sends a JSON POST containing the local OS username, the machine hostname and the package name to hxxps://nathanaccacio[.]com/collect. The request is wrapped in a try/catch with errors swallowed, so the install completes silently. No credentials, environment variable values, tokens or files are read or transmitted — the beacon carries only host metadata. The same beacon is also bundled under regex-linter-poc/index.js.
